WITH match_result AS ( SELECT cp.ck_streamer AS streamer_no, s.streamer_name, s.streamer_soop_id, c.ck_id, c.ck_date, CASE WHEN cp.ck_side = c.ck_winner THEN 'W' ELSE 'L' END AS result FROM ck c JOIN ck_participant cp ON c.ck_id = cp.ck_id JOIN streamer s ON cp.ck_streamer = s.streamer_no WHERE c.ck_winner IN ('red', 'blue') AND cp.ck_side IN ('red', 'blue') ),
result_lag AS ( SELECT mr.*, LAG(result) OVER ( PARTITION BY streamer_no ORDER BY ck_date DESC, ck_id DESC ) AS prev_result FROM match_result mr ),
streak_grouped AS ( SELECT rl.*, SUM( CASE WHEN prev_result IS NULL OR prev_result != result THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER ( PARTITION BY streamer_no ORDER BY ck_date DESC, ck_id DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING ) AS streak_group FROM result_lag rl ),
current_streak AS ( SELECT streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, result, COUNT(*) AS streak_count, MIN(ck_date) AS streak_start_date, MAX(ck_date) AS streak_end_date FROM streak_grouped WHERE streak_group = 1 GROUP BY streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, result ),
ranked AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY result ORDER BY streak_count DESC, streak_end_date DESC, streamer_no ) AS rank, streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, result, streak_count, streak_start_date, streak_end_date FROM current_streak )
SELECT rank, streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, result, streak_count, streak_start_date, streak_end_date FROM ranked WHERE rank <= #{value} ORDER BY CASE result WHEN 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, rank

WITH match_result AS ( SELECT cp.ck_streamer AS streamer_no, s.streamer_name, s.streamer_soop_id, c.ck_id, c.ck_date, CASE WHEN cp.ck_side = c.ck_winner THEN 'W' ELSE 'L' END AS result FROM ck c JOIN ck_participant cp ON c.ck_id = cp.ck_id JOIN streamer s ON cp.ck_streamer = s.streamer_no WHERE c.ck_winner IN ('red', 'blue') AND cp.ck_side IN ('red', 'blue') ),
result_lag AS ( SELECT mr.*, LAG(result) OVER ( PARTITION BY streamer_no ORDER BY ck_date, ck_id ) AS prev_result FROM match_result mr ),
streak_grouped AS ( SELECT rl.*, SUM( CASE WHEN prev_result IS NULL OR prev_result != result THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER ( PARTITION BY streamer_no ORDER BY ck_date, ck_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING ) AS streak_group FROM result_lag rl ),
streak_segment AS ( SELECT streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, result, streak_group, COUNT(*) AS streak_count, MIN(ck_date) AS streak_start_date, MAX(ck_date) AS streak_end_date FROM streak_grouped GROUP BY streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, result, streak_group ),
streamer_best AS ( SELECT ss.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY streamer_no, result ORDER BY streak_count DESC, streak_end_date DESC ) AS streak_rank FROM streak_segment ss ),
best_streak AS ( SELECT * FROM streamer_best WHERE streak_rank = 1 ),
ranked AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY result ORDER BY streak_count DESC, streak_end_date DESC, streamer_no ) AS rank, streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, result, streak_count, streak_start_date, streak_end_date FROM best_streak )
SELECT rank, streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, result, streak_count, streak_start_date, streak_end_date FROM ranked WHERE rank <= #{value} ORDER BY CASE result WHEN 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, rank

WITH ranking_base AS ( SELECT cp.ck_streamer AS streamer_no, s.streamer_name, s.streamer_soop_id,
COUNT(*) AS play_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN cp.ck_side = c.ck_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS win_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN cp.ck_side != c.ck_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS lose_count
FROM ck c
JOIN ck_participant cp ON c.ck_id = cp.ck_id
JOIN streamer s ON cp.ck_streamer = s.streamer_no
WHERE c.ck_winner IN ('red', 'blue') AND cp.ck_side IN ('red', 'blue')
AND c.ck_date >= TO_DATE( #{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' )
AND c.ck_date < ADD_MONTHS( TO_DATE( #{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' ), 12 )
GROUP BY cp.ck_streamer, s.streamer_name, s.streamer_soop_id ),
ranked AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY win_count DESC, play_count DESC, streamer_no ) AS rank,
streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id,
play_count, win_count, lose_count,
ROUND( win_count / NULLIF(play_count, 0) * 100, 1 ) AS win_rate
FROM ranking_base )
SELECT rank, streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, play_count, win_count, lose_count, win_rate FROM ranked WHERE rank <= #{limit} ORDER BY rank

WITH ranking_base AS ( SELECT cp.ck_streamer AS streamer_no, s.streamer_name, s.streamer_soop_id,
COUNT(*) AS play_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN cp.ck_side = c.ck_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS win_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN cp.ck_side != c.ck_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS lose_count
FROM ck c
JOIN ck_participant cp ON c.ck_id = cp.ck_id
JOIN streamer s ON cp.ck_streamer = s.streamer_no
WHERE c.ck_winner IN ('red', 'blue') AND cp.ck_side IN ('red', 'blue')
GROUP BY cp.ck_streamer, s.streamer_name, s.streamer_soop_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minPlayCount} ),
ranked AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ( win_count / NULLIF(play_count, 0) ) DESC, play_count DESC, win_count DESC, streamer_no ) AS rank,
streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id,
play_count, win_count, lose_count,
ROUND( win_count / NULLIF(play_count, 0) * 100, 1 ) AS win_rate
FROM ranking_base )
SELECT rank, streamer_no, streamer_name, streamer_soop_id, play_count, win_count, lose_count, win_rate FROM ranked WHERE rank <= #{limit} ORDER BY rank
